text:
Sam W: quick update — ran kv-only INT8 and FP8 trials on beta-ivy30b (2xA100 equiv) against prod traffic replay for 2h. results below, looks promising but a couple of cold-start spikes.
Lia Chen: can you paste the numbers? p50/p95 and memory delta pls.
Sam W: p50 gen latency: baseline(fp32) 42ms -> int8 37ms (-12%), fp8 35ms (-17%). p95: baseline 190ms -> int8 220ms (+16%), fp8 260ms (+37%). memory: int8 ~ -28% vs fp32, fp8 ~ -40%.
Omar R: that p95 regression for fp8 is concerning. is that cold-start only?
Sam W: mostly cold tail. cold-start traces show KV deserialization + kernel JIT jitter. warm p95 improved: baseline 120ms -> int8 130ms (+8%), fp8 145ms (+21%).
BenchBot: [AUTO] run_id=kvq-1712349876, models=ivy30b, quant_modes=[INT8,FP8], samples=45k, replay=prod-2026-03-18, metrics={p50_ms:[42,37,35],p95_ms:[190,220,260],mem_mb:[8200,5900,4920],acc_delta:[0.0,-0.6,-1.7]}
Jen K: accuracy delta is small but nonzero: fp8 -1.7% on pass@1 for our eval suite? which eval?
Sam W: eval set = conv-eval-3k (dialog + instruction mix). fp8 drop concentrated on long-turn dialog where kv gets heavily used. int8 drop ~ -0.6% mostly on numeric answers.
Lia Chen: any difference by kv eviction policy? we use eviction_threshold=0.7 for this run. can we try 0.5 and 0.9?
Sam W: yes — my hypothesis: aggressive eviction increases cold misses -> p95 spikes. 0.9 reduced fp8 p95 from 260ms -> 210ms but memory climbed ~+6%.
Ryan P: safe rollout plan: canary FP8 on dev-only cluster at 10% traffic -> monitor p95 and quality with fast-eval hook. auto-rollback if p95 + >15% relative or acc delta >1.0% on canary eval.
Omar R: we should also test hybrid: KV quantized to INT8, weights FP8 or GPTQ. does that give best of both worlds?
Sam W: ran a quick hybrid: kv=int8, weights=fp8 => p50 36ms, p95 150ms, mem -34%, acc delta -0.8%. much better tail.
Jen K: data point: hybrid acc delta tolerable. but need more runs with different seeds and longer replay. also test AWQ kernel on fp8 weights — some models show different numeric behavior.
BenchBot: [AUTO] queued follow-up runs: kvq-1712349876-ev0.5, kvq-1712349876-ev0.9, kvq-1712349876-hybrid-awq. ETA 3h each.
Lia Chen: ops question — how does batching interplay? we saw higher batch sizes amplify p95 regressions for fp8. keep batch cap at 8 for canary.
Sam W: noted. I'll prepare canary config:
```
route: canary-fp8-hybrid
traffic: 10%
model: ivy30b-v1
quant: {kv: int8, weights: fp8}
eviction_threshold: 0.9
batch_max_tokens: 2048
batch_max_items: 8
rollout: 2h -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (manual checks at each step)
rollback_conds: p95_rel>15% OR acc_delta>1.0%
```
Ryan P: add a fast-eval hook that runs conv-eval-3k every 15m and posts to #eng-ml. also add tracing for kernel JIT duration.
Omar R: one more check — ensure kv serialization format unchanged (we had a subtle protocol change last year). confirm checksums.
Sam W: verified checksums match prod. will kick off the canary after the queued runs finish. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Jen K: if hybrid looks stable, let's ship to dedicated pools only first (no public hosted) for a week.
BenchBot: [AUTO] canary scheduled at 1712384000. run links: https://bench.internal/runs/kvq-1712349876
Sam W: ack, will monitor. any other blockers?
Lia Chen: please include a short note in the release thread about the expected memory savings and fallback plan. that helps support.
Sam W: will do.
